pair_order: base,candidate on odd ordinal; candidate,base on even ordinal; preserve all 192 timing observations including warmups
append_boundary: preconstructed immutable same synthetic inputs into real WebCallbacks.log, looping over three fresh new_job owners; fixture creation outside timing; includes normalization, lock, eviction and producer loop
http_boundary: real Flask /api/jobs/<jid>/log in werkzeug make_server loopback; urllib connect, query parsing, atomic snapshot, Flask JSON encoding, complete HTTP body transfer included; JSON decode/hash outside elapsed boundary
http_samples_per_observation: 6 native full-history requests from0, then6 matched-retained-interval requests from independent expected base; rotate three jobs; one untimed matched-subset correctness GET precedes samples
equivalence: all input strings <=8192bytes and untruncated; independent newest-to-oldest count/byte recipe computes intended subset; compare every candidate full and every base/candidate matched body to full expected lines; retain SHA256, absolute base/next/count/bytes/counters and output sizes; every decoded response also verifies exact from/len/count; every baseline full body equals the complete input sequence
cache_state: fresh subprocess imports per observation; existing offline CPython3.12/OpenCV4/Flask env; normal GC; same offline model cache task-local, no inference/models/network fetch; three full warmup pairs, no selective rerun
instrumentation_after_all_timing: one base and candidate tracemalloc producer + actual route snapshot/JSON observation per each12 case/count; fresh mutable fixtures; allocate synthetic caller strings inside allocation workload then discard temporaries; no time interpretation of instrumented work; report current, append peak and snapshot/JSON peak separately
limits: local responsiveness only; no p95, global RSS, browser retention, append speedup or model/media latency claim; inputs/caller objects, Unicode object overhead, escaping, in-flight responses, allocator and job count remain separate
frozen_identity: premeasurement-hashes.json is checked before and after every observation; its immutable bytes/hash are captured by driver; expected web hash is passed into configure, not recomputed from source; observations record manifest and source hash
